app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:121-233 — large untested index builder (sort, slots, forms, generations)
coverage_of_risk.rationale: Zero tests, and none of the risky data-transformation, sorting, URL-state or error paths are covered by anything the app owns.

evidence: app/ — no spec/test files exist at all (measured tests.files: 0)
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests, so the criterion is at its floor by the anchor.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:188-201 — a reorder of the dex or id>10000 leak would fail nothing in app/
app/pages/index.vue:122-136 — debounce/URL race would fail nothing

regression_power.rationale: No test can fail, so any refactor of the data layer or URL state ships unguarded; only the external acceptance suite would notice, and only until it stops being the gate.

evidence: app/ — zero tests, zero noise (anchor: no tests = 3)
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no low-value tests either.

findings.issue: The whole index builder — species sort by dex number, type slot ordering, generation mapping, alternate-form exclusion — has no tests; it's the single most refactor-prone and failure-prone module.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest unit tests over a small fixture (2-3 species incl. one id>10000 form) asserting ordering, slot order, generation assignment and form exclusion; it is a pure-ish function behind a fetch seam that's easy to stub.

findings.issue: Filtering, pagination, URL-query serialization and the query watch are untested; bugs in page clamping, default-omission or the filter-changes-reset-page rule would ship silently.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/page/query logic into a composable and test it: 'a?b' matches 'Mr Mime' but not 'mr-mime', page=999 clamps, defaults omitted from URL, filter change resets page.

findings.issue: The sortable-column comparator (missing values last in both directions, tie fallback to level/name, aria-sort state) is pure and completely untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the comparator directly: null power sorts last ascending and descending; ties fall back to level then name; sorting doesn't mutate props.rows.

findings.issue: Not-found rendering is triggered by !data, conflating API outage (non-404 throw from apiGet) with a genuinely missing resource; untested error path.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish error from notFound in the server payload and add a test that a 500 from the API does not render 'Not found'.

findings.issue: Promise-caching logic (delete-on-error, 404 cached forever) is subtle and untested; a stuck rejected promise would poison all later requests for that URL.
findings.suggestion: Test the cache: failed fetch is not cached (second call retries), 404 result is cached as null.

findings.issue: getPokemonPageData assembles stats/total, abilities (hidden flag), version-group ordering (default = highest order) and per-game move grouping with zero tests.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot-free behavioural tests on a fixture Pokémon: stat labels, total sum, slot-ordered abilities, game select default, one row per version_group_details entry.

findings.issue: humanize, latestEnglishFlavor, collapseWhitespace and the short_effect→flavor→'—' fallback (used at :397-403) are pure spec-critical helpers with no tests.
findings.suggestion: A handful of one-line unit tests: 'mr-mime'→'Mr Mime', 'thunder-punch'→'Thunder Punch', \f/\n collapsing, effect fallback to em dash.

findings.issue: Recursive evolution-chain mapping (branching chains like Eevee) is untested.
findings.suggestion: Test mapEvolutionNode on a three-branch fixture asserting nested structure; a bad recursion silently flattens or drops branches.

findings.issue: cardsFromRefs dedupe/dex-sort/alternate-form exclusion is shared by move, ability and type pages with no tests.
findings.suggestion: Test that a learn-list containing both deoxys-normal and deoxys yields one card for species 386, sorted by id.

findings.issue: The invalid-?game= fallback (falls back to the highest-order version group) is untested; a regression would default to the wrong game with no failure.
findings.suggestion: A component test loading ?game=nonsense and asserting the select shows the latest game.

summary: The app ships zero tests — no runner, no script, nothing — while leaning on 800+ lines of sorting, filtering, pagination, URL-state and data-transformation logic that is highly unit-testable. Once the acceptance suite is no longer the gate, any refactor of the index builder, the home-page filters or the move-table comparator ships unguarded. This is the single cheapest quality win available to the codebase: pure functions and a thin composable would cover most of the risk with a few dozen lines of vitest.
